reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, correctly invoking configurational entropy and sluggish diffusion, but it oversimplifies by treating lattice distortion as the sole kinetic barrier and neglects the competing thermodynamic driving force for phase separation, which is also strongly influenced by the same atomic size differences.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and decisive, but the practical feasibility of synthesizing two nanoparticle sets that differ only in lattice distortion while keeping all other variables (composition, particle size, support) identical is extremely challenging and may be impossible.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a central question in the field with a well-structured, comparative experimental design that, if feasible, would provide valuable mechanistic insight into high-temperature nanoparticle stability.
